text:
jordan: Running FP8 / AWQ / GPTQ bakeoff on nova-13b today. Switched infra to Triton 2.1 + CUDA 20 and hit an immediate symbol error when loading trt-llm plugin. Anyone seen this combo before?

maya: seen something similar on L40s stack. Error snippet from container: 
```
trtllm_plugin.so: undefined symbol: trt_create_execution_context_v2
E tensorflow: failed to load plugin ...
```

sam: what's the container tag? we recently moved to cuda:20 base images.

jordan: image is `redwood/inference:nova-cuda20-triton2.1`. Full docker run line is `docker run --gpus all -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ... redwood/inference:nova-cuda20-triton2.1`. Log tail: 
```
[2026-11-03T09:12:14Z] trt-llm: failed to dlopen plugin: /opt/trtllm/trtllm_plugin.so: undefined symbol: trt_create_execution_context_v2
[2026-11-03T09:12:14Z] TritonServer: startup failed
```

zhen: that smells like a TRT API version mismatch — plugin built against TRT 8.6 while runtime is 8.8 in the CUDA20 image. Rebuild plugin against TRT 8.8 or pin TRT runtime. Also note vLLM path doesn't hit this because it uses custom kernels, not TRT.

jordan: rebuilt plugin against TRT 8.8 per above, symbol error cleared. New problem: AWQ FP8 kernels on TensorRT-LLM path OOM on 80GB A100 when sequence_len=4096. vLLM path with same AWQ artifact runs fine and uses less memory. Quick perf snapshot (batch=1, seq=1024/4096):
- tensorRT-LLM FP8-AWQ: 18ms/token, mem ~68GB (seq1024) -> OOM @4096
- vLLM AWQ (CUDA20): 22ms/token, mem ~45GB (seq4096 OK)
- GPTQ-INT8 (Triton): 25ms/token, mem ~50GB
- baseline fp16-vllm: 17ms/token, mem ~72GB

maya: does AWQ enable persistent KV cache on TRT path? we've seen executioncontext hold onto device memory and never release between requests. try setting cache to per-request or toggle the persistent flag.

sam: workaround so far: set `TRTLLM_CACHE_MODE=per-request` and reduce cache shards. That avoids OOM but increases latency ~10%. Also note numerical diffs: AWQ on TRT path shows +0.6 ppl on eval vs fp16 baseline; GPTQ shows +1.9 ppl. Need corpus run.

jordan: running privacy-sanitized eval set now (10k tokens, dev prompts). Early qualitatives: some prompt types (long-context instruction chains) degrade more under FP8-Trt kernels vs vLLM FP8 — suggests rounding/scale differences in kernel paths.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Rebuild job #3218 queued (trtllm-plugin w/ TRT 8.8). ETA ~12m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

zhen: next steps if rebuild + cache-mode change clear OOM: run a matrix sweep: seq_lengths = [512,1024,2048,4096], batch = [1,4], quant = [FP8-AWQ, GPTQ-INT8, AWQ-INT8], runtime = [trtllm, triton, vllm]. Log: latencies, peak_mem, ppl/delta. I'll add harness job and expected CSV schema.

jordan: thanks — will attach logs and eval CSV once jobs finish. For now flagging the Triton+TRTLLM+FP8 path as flaky until we have numeric parity checks. :warning:
